Application Data.NAME: Trophy World Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Trophy World Inc. specializes in the design, production, and retail of custom trophies and awards for various events, including sports competitions, corporate recognition, and academic achievements. Our operations include engraving and personalization services, as well as a wide selection of off-the-shelf awards. We cater to both individual customers and organizations, ensuring high-quality craftsmanship and timely delivery.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, a delivery truck accidentally struck the storefront, causing damage to the front window and signage. The estimated cost of repairs is $1,200.00. The claim is currently in progress and awaiting final approval from the insurance adjuster.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: B-rated, UL-listed TL-15 safe, equipped with biometric access control.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Enhanced security measures in place, including a 24-hour monitored alarm system, on-site security personnel during business hours, and perimeter fencing to restrict unauthorized access.

Sample Reviews: I was extremely disappointed with my experience at this trophy shop. The staff was unhelpful and seemed disinterested in assisting me with my order, and when the trophies finally arrived, several had spelling mistakes on the engravings. To make matters worse, it took weeks to resolve the issue, and I ended up needing to go elsewhere for a last-minute event.
The trophy shop provided a wide selection of high-quality awards at reasonable prices, and the staff was helpful in assisting with my custom engraving requests.

I recently visited the local trophy and awards shop to order a customized plaque for a community event. The staff was knowledgeable and assisted me in selecting the right design and material options, ensuring my specifications were met. The final product was delivered on time and looked great, though I found the pricing to be a bit higher than expected for a similar service elsewhere.
I was disappointed with the poor quality of the trophies I received; the engravings were messy and the materials felt cheap.
The shop offers a decent selection of trophies and awards at reasonable prices, but the customer service could use some improvement.

Final Reason: While the initial decision was ACCEPT, the third-party data indicates a higher total loss amount of $9,734 and a history of 2 claims, which raises concerns about the business's risk profile. Additionally, the customer reviews reflect mixed experiences, with some negative feedback regarding service quality and product defects. This could impact future claims and overall business stability. A more thorough review may be warranted.
